_readme: External things the harness depends on, pinned. `mode` is reference (installed from upstream, never edited), vendored (copied into skills/ with upstream license), or cli. `ref` is the upstream commit or tag verified on `checked`. Update refs deliberately and record why in an ADR or change.

mise.role: Node and Python for hooks and CLIs; shims work in non-interactive shells

jq.via: mise when the OS has no jq
jq.role: JSON parsing in hooks and the installer

skills.role: installs skills into each agent's directory via symlink

impeccable.role: UI commands (audit, critique, polish, ...). `init` is not used; DESIGN.md follows the Google spec instead

grilling.role: mandatory interview before any spec decision
grilling.install: npx -y skills@latest add mattpocock/skills --skill grilling -g -a claude-code -y

grill-me.install: npx -y skills@latest add mattpocock/skills --skill grill-me -g -a claude-code -y

handoff.role: compact a conversation into a handoff document
handoff.install: npx -y skills@latest add mattpocock/skills --skill handoff -g -a claude-code -y

writing-for-agents.role: rules for writing SKILL.md and AGENTS.md
writing-for-agents.install: npx -y skills@latest add mattpocock/skills --skill writing-for-agents -g -a claude-code -y

humanizer.role: English prose de-AI pass; accepts voice samples
humanizer.status: installed globally now; wiring into en-writing is phase 3

agent-style.role: 21 English writing rules, adapters per tool

expo-skills.role: React Native / Expo guidance for monolith
expo-skills.status: project-level install in Expo repositories (phase 4); not installed globally

frontend-design.status: phase 3; Claude plugin from the official marketplace
